title: Bollywood Dance Workshop
description: Join Minakshi for a Bollywood Dance Workshop: warm-up, hip-hop techniques, 'Kala Chashma' choreography and a launch party. All welcome!
long_description:
Join Minakshi for a Bollywood Dance Workshop: warm-up, hip-hop techniques, 'Kala Chashma' choreography and a launch party. All welcome!

About this Event

What to expect
We'll start with a warm-up, then learn 3 hip-hop techniques you can use anywhere. Then we'll put it all together into a fun choreography on "Kala Chashma." No experience needed, everybody is welcome, and we go at a pace that works for all of us.
We'll also film a short reel together (only if you want to be in it!).
After class, we celebrate with a launch party for GlobalBelonging, and you'll take home a goody bag.
Come as you are. Let's dance, laugh, and have fun!
Learn more about our community at www.globalbelonging.com
